text: Two of the top reviews on this Steam demo say it's a crypto miner.
It isn't. But players are seeing ninety nine percent GPU load sitting in the menu, doing nothing.
Steam publishes the file list for every demo, so I read this one. There's no miner in it.
What's in it is the High Definition Render Pipeline. The heavy one, that almost no small team picks.
Plus, apparently, nothing capping the frame rate. So your fans spin up on a still menu screen.
That's the whole mystery. A graphics default, and no frame limiter.
If you're shipping a demo, cap your frame rate in the menu. Or the internet decides you're a miner.
Full teardown on the channel. This is Demo Dip.
